data: Sort and filter at the column
Open controls from a column header, preview a sort and filter by counted values.

Open sort and filter from a column header. Hover over the column letter and click its chevron. The toolbar and command palette open the same controls. Scratch shows the affected range. Filter rows.

See the proposed sort order. Choose ascending or descending to see a sample of the rows that would come first. Click Apply Sort to rearrange the data. Sort rows.

Filter by counted values or type to search. Pick one or more values when the column has a short list. Press Return to keep the filter or Escape to restore the previous filter and selection. Named tables.
